rationale: Under the two declared development evaluation cases at configured result count k=1 and the executed local model, no compared configuration returned the reviewed relevant retrieval unit F-A: aggregate recall@1 is 0 of 2 for every configuration and every returned unit was judged not relevant. The measured query latency was 0.035 s for lexical retrieval, 0.634 s for embedding-based retrieval, 0.375 s for hybrid retrieval and 0.391 s for lexical retrieval followed by embedding-based reranking, with no execution failures, so the embedding-based candidate adds latency and model encodes without any relevance gain. The evidence does not support adopting the embedding-based candidate configuration in place of the lexical experiment baseline, so the bounded decision retains the lexical retrieval configuration for these declared cases only.
